# Lakeside Fulfillment

> Lakeside Fulfillment is a DTC-specialized third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse in Austin, Texas. Orders ship the same day, Monday to Friday, when they are in by the carrier cutoff: USPS 2 PM CT, UPS 6 PM CT. Delivery across the U.S. takes 3-5 days.

Lakeside receives, stores, picks, packs and ships orders for direct-to-consumer brands. Orders reach Lakeside through ShipStation, which connects to Shopify, WooCommerce and most other carts. Every client gets a live dashboard for inventory, orders and shipments, with reorder notifications. Pricing ranges are published on the pricing page. A custom quote arrives within 24 hours with no commitment, and onboarding can take as little as 2 weeks.

## Key facts

- Name: Lakeside Fulfillment
- What it is: a DTC-specialized 3PL (third-party logistics) and fulfillment warehouse
- Address: 3100 Scott Dr, STE 201, Austin, TX 78734, United States
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM CT. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Closed for holidays: November 26 and 27, 2026; December 25, 2026; January 1, 2027
- Phone: (737) 343-2348
- Email: inboundleads@lakesidefulfillment.com
- Same-day shipping, Monday to Friday: USPS orders in by 2 PM CT and UPS orders in by 6 PM CT ship the same day. USPS orders after 2 PM CT, any order after 6 PM CT, and weekend orders ship the next business day. There is no weekend shipping.
- Delivery: 3-5 days across the U.S. from Austin, Texas
- Services: DTC fulfillment; B2B and wholesale; inventory management; returns processing; subscription boxes and kitting; freight and receiving; Amazon FBA prep; product labeling
- Client dashboard: live inventory, orders and shipments, with reorder notifications
- Store connections: ShipStation, which connects to Shopify, WooCommerce and most carts
- Warehouse: 5,500 sq ft in Austin; your contact is the owner
- Getting started: custom quote within 24 hours, no commitment; onboarding in as little as 2 weeks

## Published pricing (USD)

- Pick and pack, light (under 8 oz, poly mailer): $1.50-$2.50 per order
- Pick and pack, medium (8 oz to 1.5 lb, boxed): $3.00-$3.75 per order
- Pick and pack, heavy or fragile (over 1.5 lb, or needs a sturdy box and protective fill): $3.95-$5.25 per order
- Each additional item in an order: $0.50-$0.75
- Storage: $45.00 per pallet per month, flat
- Inbound receiving: $15.00 per carton, $25.00 per pallet
- Product labeling: $0.50-$0.75 per unit
- Amazon FBA prep: $1.25-$1.50 per unit
- Onboarding: $150.00-$250.00, one time
- Monthly minimum for smaller accounts: $300.00-$350.00
- The standard mailer or box is included in pick and pack. Postage is billed separately. Amazon FBM orders are billed at the same rate as DTC orders.
